{{Top|leg}}
'''Root lizards''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. They were one of the creatures preyed upon by the [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwing]], along with [[Vine snake/Legends|vine snakes]].<ref name="CCG-Bog-wing">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Bog-wing (Dark)}}</ref>
